slides: Sleep isn’t a luxury; it’s the fuel line for every rep.
During deep sleep, growth hormone spikes, repairing micro‑tears.
A 90‑minute cycle syncs cortisol drops with muscle recovery.
Missing one cycle equals a 15% dip in power output the next day.
Prioritize whole‑cycle rest before you chase the next set.
Your day is a ledger of tiny votes.
Each ‘yes’ adds weight to the future you’re drafting.
Each ‘no’ subtracts the noise that dilutes focus.
The sum of 365 votes outruns any single grand resolution.
Vote deliberately—your future self will audit the tally.
Plateaus are the body’s way of saying ‘I’m bored.’
Muscles adapt to the exact stress you repeat.
Swap a squat for a pistol, a row for a kettlebell swing.
Novel vectors force new fiber recruitment and neural pathways.
Keep the script fresh; progress follows curiosity.
Motivation is a spark; ritual is the furnace.
A 5‑minute anchor routine triggers the brain’s habit loop.
Consistency lowers the activation energy for the next action.
When the loop runs, effort feels like continuation, not start.
Design a starter ritual and let momentum carry the work.
